name: Vue
one_liner: Component framework with a gentler learning curve and a more complete default stack.
what_it_is: A UI framework using single-file components that colocate template, script and style. Vue 3 introduced a composition API similar in spirit to React hooks, alongside an official router and state library.
why_it_matters: Vue occupies a deliberate middle ground: more batteries-included than React, less prescriptive than Angular. Its official ecosystem means fewer architecture decisions per project, which is worth real money on small teams. It is a first-class choice, not a consolation one.
suitable_for: Teams that want official routing and state rather than choosing from competing libraries
Developers coming from a template-oriented background
Progressive enhancement of existing server-rendered pages
not_suitable_for: Organisations whose hiring is built around React experience
Codebases needing niche libraries that only ever ship React bindings
